title: Natural Language Autoencoders: Turning Claude's Thoughts into Text
summary: Anthropic 发布自然语言自编码器技术，能够将 Claude 的内部思维过程转化为可读的文本描述。这一突破性研究首次实现了对大型语言模型推理过程的透明化解读，为理解模型行为、检测幻觉和提升安全性提供了全新工具。该工作被视为可解释AI领域的重要里程碑。

title: Scaling Trusted Access for Cyber with GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5-Cyber
raw_excerpt: OpenAI expands Trusted Access for Cyber with GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5-Cyber, helping verified defenders accelerate vulnerability research and protect critical infrastructure.
summary: OpenAI 扩展其“可信访问”网络安全计划，推出 GPT-5.5 和 GPT-5.5-Cyber 模型，专为经过验证的安全研究人员设计，用于加速漏洞研究和关键基础设施保护。此举标志着AI在网络安全领域的应用从通用走向专业化，为防御者提供更强大的工具。

title: Advancing voice intelligence with new models in the API
raw_excerpt: Explore new realtime voice models in the OpenAI API that can reason, translate, and transcribe speech, enabling more natural and intelligent voice experiences.
summary: OpenAI 发布三款全新实时语音模型：GPT-Realtime-2（具备推理能力）、GPT-Realtime-Translate（实时翻译）和 GPT-Realtime-Whisper（实时转录）。这些模型可在API中实现边听边思考、翻译和转录，为开发者构建更自然的语音交互应用提供了强大基础。

title: Higher usage limits for Claude and a compute deal with SpaceX
raw_excerpt: Anthropic increased usage limits for Claude through a new compute partnership with SpaceX, accessing over 220,000 NVIDIA GPUs. This expansion follows deals with Amazon, Google, Broadcom, Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Fluidstack for significant compute capacity. The company also plans international expansion to address compliance needs for enterprise customers in regulated industries.
summary: Anthropic 通过与 SpaceX 达成计算合作，获得超过22万块NVIDIA GPU的算力，大幅提升了Claude的使用限制。该合作是Anthropic一系列算力扩张计划的一部分，此前已与亚马逊、谷歌、微软等达成类似协议，旨在满足企业客户日益增长的需求。

title: Claude adds Self-Improving Agents
raw_excerpt: Claude Managed Agents launched features like dreaming, outcomes, and multiagent orchestration. Dreaming enhances agent improvement by analyzing past sessions to identify patterns, while outcomes allow agents to self-correct based on predefined success criteria. Multiagent orchestration optimizes complex task management by enabling agents to delegate tasks to specialized subagents, as utilized by companies like Harvey, Netflix, Spiral by Every, and Wisedocs.
summary: Claude Managed Agents 推出三大新功能：Dreaming（通过分析历史会话自动改进）、Outcomes（基于预设成功标准自我纠正）和多智能体编排（将任务委派给专业子智能体）。这些功能使AI代理能够自主优化和协作，已被Harvey、Netflix等企业采用。

title: China to Invest in DeepSeek at $50 Billion Valuation
raw_excerpt: DeepSeek is in talks to raise money from China's National Artificial Intelligence Industry Investment Fund, a one-year-old government-backed fund with around $8.8 billion in capital. The startup aims to raise a few billion dollars in the new round, which values it at around $50 billion. DeepSeek is a key component in China's plan to have top-class homegrown companies in a range of AI fields. The strategy is a way to hedge against US export controls and to take leadership in bringing AI to the world.
summary: 据《华尔街日报》报道，中国AI公司DeepSeek正与国家级AI产业投资基金洽谈融资，估值约500亿美元。该基金规模约88亿美元，旨在培育本土AI领军企业以应对美国出口管制。DeepSeek被视为中国AI战略的关键组成部分。

title: Mozilla says 271 vulnerabilities found by Mythos and "almost no false positives"
summary: Mozilla 宣布其AI安全工具Mythos在Firefox中发现了271个漏洞，且“几乎没有误报”。这一成果展示了AI在代码安全审计中的巨大潜力，Mythos由Anthropic的Claude驱动，能够高效识别传统工具难以发现的复杂安全缺陷。

title: 一年磨一剑，今年最炸机器人Demo来了！
raw_excerpt: 1亿美元种子轮团队出手，单个模型解锁单手打蛋解魔方弹钢琴
summary: 一家获得1亿美元种子轮融资的机器人初创公司发布最新Demo，其单个模型能够控制机器人完成单手打蛋、解魔方、弹钢琴等精细操作。该成果展示了具身智能在灵巧操作领域的重大突破，标志着机器人从简单抓取向复杂技能迈出关键一步。

title: z-lab/dflash
raw_excerpt: DFlash: Block Diffusion for Flash Speculative Decoding
summary: GitHub上开源项目DFlash（Block Diffusion for Flash Speculative Decoding）今日获得671星。该项目提出了一种基于块扩散的投机解码方法，可显著加速大模型推理速度，为降低AI推理成本提供了新思路，受到开发者社区广泛关注。

title: LearningCircuit/local-deep-research
raw_excerpt: ~95% on SimpleQA (e.g. Qwen3.6-27B on a 3090). Supports all local and cloud LLMs (llama.cpp, Ollama, Google, ...). 10+ search engines - arXiv, PubMed, your private documents. Everything Local & Encrypted.
summary: 开源项目local-deep-research今日获得559星，它允许用户在本地运行深度研究AI代理，在SimpleQA基准上达到约95%的准确率（使用Qwen3.6-27B模型）。支持所有本地和云端LLM，集成10+搜索引擎，所有数据本地加密，为隐私敏感的研究工作提供了强大工具。
